73.
(1)  A  market  institution  shall  file  with  the
Commission  an  annual  report,  within  five  months  of  the
date of its balance sheet, which shall include-

(a)
a report on the corporate governance policy of the
market  institution  and  any  other  information
required by the Commission;

(b)
audited financial statements prepared in accordance
with  Sri  Lanka’s  Accounting  Standards  and  such
other requirements as may be specified in the rules;
and

(c)
consolidated financial statements, where the market
institution  is  a  holding  company  or  a  subsidiary
where appropriate.
(2) The financial statements to be included in an annual
report under subsection (1) shall be audited in accordance
with Sri Lanka’s Auditing Standards.
